top_signals.title: Snap-on CEO on Tariffs and China Risks
top_signals.summary: Snap-on CEO Nick Pinchuk joins Bloomberg Open Interest to discuss US manufacturing conditions, including rising diesel and material costs, how large vs. small manufacturers are coping, the impact of reshoring on hiring and why tariffs and Chinese competition are central to long-term planning. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
